name: Gorgemaw, the Grave Glutton
behaviour: Throws a chain hook down a telegraphed lane and drags the hero in; a roll slips it. Up close it swings a cleaver or swallows the hero for two seconds, chewing through armour to heal itself (Blade Spin resists). Its grave stench poisons within 4 m, and when hurt it eats its own shamblers to heal.
look: Bloated grave-glutton with a huge stitched belly and a small head; a chain hook in its right hand, a broad cleaver in its left.
